user_story: As a user, I want to be prevented from registering with an already-used email so that duplicate accounts are avoided.

positive.title: User successfully registers with a new email
steps: Fill out the remaining required fields
positive.expected_result: User is successfully registered and directed to the welcome page.

negative.title: User attempts to register with an already-used email
steps: Enter an email address that is already associated with an existing account
Fill out the remaining required fields
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email is already in use.

edge.title: User attempts to register with an email that has different casing but is identical
steps: Enter an email address with different case, e.g., 'Test@Example.com' when 'test@example.com' is already registered
Fill out the remaining required fields
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email is already in use.
